create_raw_graph: create a RawGraph dataclass instance from a full adjacency matrix, features, and labels for node classification or link prediction
build_subgraph_batch: build a batched subgraph by concatenating multiple Subgraph instances into block diagonal form using cat_to_block_diagonal
encode_entity_features: encode entity features with hop, ppr, and drnl annotations via EntityEncoding and convert to one-hot vectors for neural network input
convert_subgraph_to_csr: convert a Subgraph instance to a scipy sparse CSR matrix using the to_csr_sp method
validate_graph_structure: validate a RawGraph or Subgraph instance to ensure feature sizes, label sizes, and adjacency dimensions are consistent
